summary: Full regression + iteration_3 new features tested. Backend: 34/34 pytest passing (added 12 new tests covering /api/stats, /api/analyze/demo real gpt-5.4 vision, favorite toggle + stats.favorites recompute, price_estimate -> price_value recompute, share_id stable + owner-scoped, /api/public/component/{share_id} without auth, /api/public/image/{share_id} without auth, unknown share 404s). Existing 22 tests (auth, analyze, offers, history, files, delete, cross-user isolation) still pass. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: login theo@test.com -> Home with StatsBar (4 cards) -> Demo btn triggered real gpt-5.4 (identified 'Processeur AMD Ryzen 7 3700X', 60-100 €, Élevée) -> favorite toggle -> Share btn copied /c/f8b9f08101 URL to clipboard -> 4 real AI offers -> jsPDF exported -> Edit persists -> Stats bar updated (count=2, favoris=1) -> history search filters 1 result, filter-fav shows 1, compare-toggle -> compare-select 2 items -> compare-modal opens -> delete works -> Public share page /c/{share_id} fetched in fresh browser context (no cookies): 200 OK, H1='Carte graphique NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080', image loaded at naturalWidth=800, footer 'fait par theo pour le bac 2026-2027' present -> logout returns to Auth. Footer credit exact. No blockers.

minor.issue: Returns image_url ('/api/public/image/{share_id}') even when doc.storage_path is missing? Actually it correctly returns '' in that case, but shape docs the empty string only implicitly. Consider omitting the key or returning null for clearer contract.
?auth= session token still passed in URL query (carried from iteration_2). Consider signed URLs.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext runs on the public route too and fires GET /api/auth/me returning 401 for anonymous visitors. Non-blocking (PublicComponent renders correctly), but produces console errors and unnecessary network traffic for shared links. Consider skipping checkAuth() when route matches /c/:shareId or scoping AuthProvider under a non-public branch of the router.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — cosmetic a11y warning; wrap with DialogDescription or add aria-describedby to remove the warning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Skip auth check on /c/:shareId to avoid 401 noise for anonymous share visitors (see integration_issues).
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription to CompareModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
OPTIONAL: Return a stable shape for /api/public/component image_url (null vs empty string).
Iteration_2 unresolved code-review items still stand (see critical_code_review_comments).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _run_analysis still keeps a saved analysis doc with empty image_url when put_object fails. Consider transactional cleanup or a 502 to the client.
server.py: storage_key lazy init is not lock-protected; concurrent first requests may double-init. Use asyncio.Lock or move init to startup task.
server.py: requests.post/get in put_object/get_object/google_session/analyze_demo are SYNC calls inside async endpoints — they block the event loop. Move to httpx.AsyncClient.
server.py: /api/analysis/{id}/offers $set filter is by id only; add user_id to the update filter for defense in depth.

server.py: /api/public/component and /api/public/image expose a share_id lookup on the analyses collection — no rate limiting. Brute force of 10-char hex share_ids is still ~2^40 space but rate-limiting the public route is prudent.
server.py: DEMO_IMAGE_URL is a hotlinked Unsplash asset. If Unsplash rotates or rate-limits the URL, /api/analyze/demo will 502. Consider caching the sample to object storage on startup.
Home.jsx exportPdf: fixed y-coordinate for description lines; long descriptions still overflow. Use jsPDF page-break logic (splitTextToSize returns lines, iterate and doc.addPage() when y > 270).
PublicComponent.jsx: makes ASSET-relative img request without falling back if data.image_url is empty. Add a placeholder or skip rendering the when image_url is falsy.

AuthContext.jsx: axios.defaults.withCredentials=true is global. On /c/:shareId this causes credentialed calls to /api/auth/me. Scope to a dedicated axios instance and/or skip checkAuth for the public route.
CompareModal.jsx: uses inline gridTemplateColumns and ROWS metadata but no semantic table -> accessibility poor. Consider a semantic <table> or grid with aria-labels.
pytest.ini pins DB_NAME=test_database in .env — same DB used for real and test data. TEST_ prefix helps but there is still no cleanup fixture; test users/analyses accumulate across runs.

iter3 fixtures use module scope while auth_client/other_client are session-scoped, mixing scopes can cause fixture teardown-order surprises with pytest-xdist loadscope. Currently harmless because module and session teardown both run at end of the worker.
test_credentials: theo@test.com / test1234 (works). Additional dynamic users iter3_<hex>@compotest.example.com created via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Test users iter3_* + test_* accumulate in test_database. No cleanup fixture added this iteration. Real gpt-5.4 analyses are stored in Emergent object storage (small JPGs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_component_detector.py -v` from /app or /app/backend. All 34 tests pass with the pinned xdist config in /app/backend/pytest.ini. Iteration_3 features are fully verified: /api/stats, /api/analyze/demo (real gpt-5.4 vision + storage), is_favorite toggle + stats recompute, /api/analysis/{id}/share, /api/public/component/{share_id}, /api/public/image/{share_id}. Frontend testids present and functional: stats-bar, demo-btn, favorite-btn, share-btn, history-search, filter-category, filter-sort, filter-fav, compare-toggle, compare-select, open-compare, compare-modal, sound-toggle, footer-credit. Note: AuthContext runs on public /c/:shareId route causing an expected but noisy 401 on /api/auth/me — main agent may want to gate that call to non-public routes.
rca of the issue: No production bug found this iteration. Only test-file fix: /api/ root health message returns 'ScanRescue API' (rebranded from CompoScan) — updated the assertion in test_root_health from 'CompoScan API' to 'ScanRescue API'.
